description: Modern apartment with air conditioning and a fully equipped kitchen. Located equidistant between the medical school and the main campus making it great for mixed student couples. The building has an elevator.
Premium luxury apartment in a new building complex near the clinics. Features smart home heating and premium appliances. Ideal for international students looking for high comfort and security.

Compact flat specifically designed for a solitary student. It is located in a quiet cul de sac behind the medical university. The owner speaks fluent English and is very helpful with international tenants.

Three bedroom apartment facing the inner courtyard so it is completely silent despite being on a busy road near the clinics. Perfect for serious medical students who need absolute silence for studying.
Practical student flat with easy to clean surfaces and tiled floors. Designed for hassle free living near the hospital. The landlord provides a cleaning service once a month included in the price.
Bright apartment with a south facing balcony that gets sun all day. Located in a quiet side street near the clinics. The kitchen is small but functional.
Empty apartment waiting for furniture. Great for long term tenants who have their own stuff. The location is prime for medical students right across from the theoretical building.
High tech apartment with fast internet pre installed and smart lighting. Ideal for tech savvy medical students. Located within walking distance of the new clinical block.
Renovated civic flat with a modern twist. Includes a walk in closet. Located in a quiet street parallel to the clinics making the commute very short.
Freshly painted apartment with new carpets. Very clean and hypoallergenic. Located near the tram stop that goes directly to the clinics.

Large newly renovated flat in the city center with direct tram access to the main building. Perfect for a group of friends who want to enjoy the city nightlife while having easy commute options. Includes a huge balcony.

Unfurnished apartment for those who want to bring their own style. It features beautiful hardwood floors and freshly painted walls. The location is unbeatable just steps away from the main university building.

Classic civic style apartment with high ceilings and thick walls that keep it cool in summer. Located on the tram line halfway between downtown and the university. Includes a dedicated study corner in each room.
Massive student apartment with four separate rooms. Ideal for a large group of friends who want to live together near the main campus. Large communal living room and two bathrooms.
Modern flat in a gated community with a private parking spot included. Very safe and secure. Walking distance to the main university building and the botanical garden.
Artistic apartment with colorful walls and unique vintage furniture. Located in the heart of the student district with ruin bars and copy shops downstairs. Not for those sensitive to city noise.
Sophisticated apartment in a historical building with very high ceilings. It feels much larger than it is. Located on the main tram line just two stops from the university main gate.
Three room apartment perfect for three individual students. Each room has its own lock for privacy. Shared kitchen and bath are spacious. Located right next to the campus library.
Executive style apartment suitable for PhD students or professors. Very elegant decor and high quality furniture. Located in the most prestigious part of the Great Forest area.
Spacious flat with a large american style kitchen and living room area. Great for social students who like to host dinner parties. Located in the vibrant city center near the tram.
Cozy attic apartment with sloping ceilings and skylights. Very romantic and quiet atmosphere. Located just a stone throw away from the main university building.
Prestigious apartment in a villa building. Shared garden usage included. Very upscale and quiet perfect for focused studying. Near the tram terminus.
Standard student flat in a tower block. Great view from the balcony. The building has a concierge. Located right on the tram line to university.
Double story duplex apartment with four bedrooms. Massive space for a large group. Includes two bathrooms and a guest toilet. In the heart of the city center.

A bright and spacious apartment located right next to the Great Forest park. It is perfect for medical students who need a quiet environment to study but want to be close to the clinics. The living room has large windows facing the trees.
Luxurious penthouse style apartment with a huge roof terrace. Amazing views over the Great Forest. High end finishings throughout and very close to the aquaticum thermal baths.
Bright and airy corner flat with views of the city. Located at a major transport hub giving easy access to both the IT campus and the main building. The furniture is modern Scandinavian style.
Modern minimalist flat with white walls and sleek furniture. Very easy to keep clean. Located halfway between the IT campus and Main campus making it flexible for different majors.

Cozy studio flat ideal for a single computer science student. It is located just a short walk from the IT faculty buildings. The space is compact but very well organized with a modern desk and comfortable chair included.
Budget friendly small garzon flat near the swimming complex. It is older but clean and well maintained by a friendly owner. Very low utility costs make it perfect for saving money.
Spacious one bedroom flat with a large separate kitchen. It is located in a family friendly neighborhood near the Kassai road campus. Great for a student couple who cooks at home often.
Partially furnished flat offering a bed frame and wardrobe but no mattress or desk. Good for students who want to customize their setup. Located near the Főnix Hall and IT campus.
Simple and clean flat on the outskirts of the Kassai campus area. It is a bit of a walk to the bus stop but the price reflects the distance. Very quiet neighbors.
Compact bachelor pad near the law and IT faculties. Features a fold down bed to maximize daytime space. Very close to cheap canteens and student grocery stores.
Sunlit apartment with huge windows and a view of the park. It includes air conditioning for the hot summer months. Very close to the campus swimming pool.
Ground floor flat with bars on windows for security. Very cool in summer. Located in a safe neighborhood near the law faculty.
Modern studio with a sleeping alcove. Very well designed layout. Located next to the Főnix event hall and close to campus.

Stylish loft apartment with high ceilings and an open plan kitchen. It is situated in a popular student area with many cafes and gyms nearby. Both bedrooms are equally sized which avoids arguments between roommates.

Affordable ground floor apartment in a quiet residential street near the engineering faculty. It is simple and modest but has everything a student needs including a renovated bathroom and sturdy furniture.

Quiet garden access apartment perfect for students with a small pet or who like to sit outside. It is a bit further from the center but very peaceful and private. The kitchen was recently refurbished.
Tiny but functional mini studio for a student on a strict budget. Includes a gallery bed to save space and a small kitchenette. Located very close to the engineering faculty entrance.
Newly built condo with excellent insulation and low overheads. Located in a rapidly developing area near the engineering campus. Includes a dishwasher and washing machine.
Older style apartment that has been well cared for. Furniture is retro but comfortable. Extremely affordable option for a single engineering student.
Large apartment with three bedrooms and a dining hall. Good for a group of engineering students. plenty of desk space in every room.
Sunny flat located directly across from the economics faculty sports grounds. The area is very green and peaceful. The apartment features a large pantry and separate toilet and bathroom.
Renovated panel apartment with insulated windows and new radiators. Very warm in winter and efficient on utilities. Located right next to a large supermarket and the economics campus.
Charming brick apartment in a greenery filled area. The flat has a rustic feel with wooden beams. It is a peaceful retreat near the agricultural and economics faculty.
Family friendly apartment that is also great for students who want a homey vibe. Large kitchen with a dining table. Located near the sports fields of the agricultural campus.
Clean and tidy flat with two separate bedrooms. Ideal for two friends sharing. Located near the farmers market and the economics campus.
Small but cheerful flat with yellow walls and sunny aspect. Very low maintenance. Perfect for a student at the nearby agricultural faculty.
